title: SimBase: A Simple Baseline for Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: For cross-modal interaction, SimBase only employs an element-wise product instead of intricate multimodal fusion.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Remarkably, SimBase achieves state-of-the-art results on two large-scale datasets.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Most of these designs focus on two primary objectives: • Facilitating cross-modal fusion: These approaches aim to integrate visual and textual modalities at different levels of granularity for precise grounding.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Surprisingly, SimBase achieves strong results on two large-scale benchmarks, notably surpassing state-of-the-art method by a significant margin on the Charades-STA benchmark.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: While recent advances in temporal grounding have led to impressive performance, they have also driven network architectures toward greater complexity, with a range of methods to (1) capture temporal relationships and (2) achieve effective multimodal fusion.
